{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Support for shifting responsibility for environmental regulation from the federal bureaucracy to the states.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for transforming the EPA into an independent bipartisan commission, similar to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission, with structural safeguards against politicized science.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for strictly limiting congressional delegation of rule-making authority.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for compensating citizens for regulatory takings.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to the legal practice known as \"sue and settle,\" in which environmental groups sue federal agencies whose officials are complicit in the litigation so that, with the taxpayers excluded, both parties can reach agreement behind closed doors.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for reforming the Equal Access to Justice Act to cap and disclose payments made to environmental activists and return the Act to its original intent.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The environment is improving year by year.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Air and waterways are much healthier than they were a few decades ago.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Pollution has been drastically reduced.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Recycling has been mainstreamed.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The public has been educated regarding environmental issues.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Ecological degradation has been avoided.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Air pollution will continue to decline for the next several decades due to technological turnover of aging equipment.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Party environmental extremists routinely ignore costs, exaggerate benefits, and advocate the breaching of constitutional boundaries by federal agencies to impose environmental regulation.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The environmental establishment looks the other way when environmental degradation is caused by the EPA and other federal agencies.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
